full_judgment:
The petitioners filed an application as per provision of Section 9 of the অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ আইন-২০০১ (As amended) before the  অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ অতিরিক্ত ট্রাইব্যুনাল, and the Tribunal entry the application being No. অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ মামলা নং- ৭৩৪/২০১২. In the said application, applicant sought a decree for "নালিশী (ক) তপশিল ভূমি যাহা গত ০৩-০৪-২০১২ইং তারিখে বাংলাদেশ গেজেট অতিরিক্ত সংখ্যায় (ক) তপসিল তালিকায় ১১৩, ১৩৩ ও ১৩৪নং ক্রমিকে ভি, পি মিসকেস যথাক্রমে ৭/উল্লা/৬৫-৬৬, ১৪/উল্লা/৭৩, ২৫/উল্লা/৭৯-৮০, ৩৭/উল্লা/৬৭-৬৮, ৯১/উল্লা/৭৯-৮০, ১৮১ ও ১৮২/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ১৭৯/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ১৮৫/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ১৯০/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ১৯৫/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ১৯৬/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ১৯৭/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ২১০/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ২১১/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ২১২/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ২১৩/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, ২১৪/উল্লা/৬৬-৬৭, মূলে প্রকাশ করা হয়েছে, উহা অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পন আইন, ২০০১ (সংশোধিত ২০১১) এর ৯ ধারা বিধান মোতাবেক প্রত্যর্পনযোগ্য হেতু (ক) তপশিল সম্পত্তির তালিকা হইতে অবমুক্ত মর্মে ঘোষনা” in respect of 57.96 acres of land described in the application and alleging inter alia that the case property originally belongs to Sree Chittaranjan Sarker, Sree Nobo Kumer Sarker and Sree Ronjit Kumer Sarker and during the S.A Survey S.A. Khatian rightly published in their name and thereafter Sree Chittaranjan Sarker died leaving two sons namely Sree Asit Kumar Sarker and Sree Manik Lal Sarker and then Sree Nobo Kumer Sarker and. Sree Ronjit Kumar Sarker died on issueless in this country and they have been owning and possessing the scheduled property by way of Successor in interest in respect of 46.12 acres and Co-sharer in possession by lease in respect of 11.84 acres and then the petitioners came to know that the Nobo Kumar and Ronojit share's i.e. 2/3 declared as enemy property and for which the petitioners as plaintiffs filed partition suit being Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 in the Court of Sub-ordinate Judge, Sirajgonj impleading respondent No. 2 (herein) Deputy Custodian, vested and non-residence (land & building) property and other 28 persons as defendants, wherein Government of Bangladesh i.e. Deputy Custodian, vested and non-residence (land & building) property contested the suit by filing written statement. And then on consideration of the evidence on record and documents and also witnesses of the contesting parties, the learned Sub-ordinate Judge decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiff petitioners and accordingly the plaintiff petitioners got 12.60 acres of land by saham by judgment and decree dated 29.03.1990. More so, government did not preferred any appeal against the said judgment and decree dated 29.03.1990. And that on publication Gazette Notification dated 03.04.2012 as per provision of Section 9 of অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ আইন-২০০১, including the schedule land described in the application as 'Ka' schedule and for which the petitioners filed the application sought for a decree to declared that the schedule land is liable to be Prottarpon in favour to the petitioners. 

 8. The case land was rightly recorded and published in C.S. and S.A. Khatian in the name of predecessor of the petitioners and it was never included as Enemy Property and the case land was not included in the Census List. More so, on 27.03.1974 repealed the Vested Law. On 31.07.1984 the then President of Bangladesh in conference of the Hindu Community was pleased enough to declare that on and that date declaration or leasing out any further land as Enemy or Vested Property would stand stopped. Following the declaration Memo No. CST72(2)/84-81(7) dated 06.08.1984 a circular was issued to that effect from the office of the President's Secretariate. Since then there was neither any scope for the subordinate Government officials to bring any new land under the clutches of Vested Property. After came to know that the respondent No.2 tried to leased out the suit property to some unknown person and leased out some portion and then the petitioners compelled to institute Title Suit being No.90 of 1986 in the Court of Sub-ordinate Judge, Sirajgonj for partition of their share impleading respondent No.2 as defendant No.1 and on contest the suit was decree vide judgment and decree dated 21.03.1990.
